title: Chapter 529 - 529 Food Streamer; Delicious!
content:
Chapter 529 - 529 Food Streamer; Delicious!

Chapter 529 - 529 Food Streamer; Delicious!

529 Food Streamer; Delicious!

Soon, a large number of comments appeared like raindrops.

Natsuya Kira: [That’s great. I’ve long wanted to try the Time Restaurant.]

Shrimp Eyes: [Just looking at the decorations, I think the food is very good.]

Xuanyuan Longyi: [Such a big restaurant. It’s over. It’s going to expose Haiyan’s inexperienced appearance again.]

Tomb of Heaven and Earth: [Go in quickly.]

Trembling BBB: [Let’s donate a little, in case Haiyan can’t afford to eat later.]

…

As more and more comments appeared, the number of gifts also increased.

Li Haiyan’s small eyes immediately turned into slits as she smiled.

However, in the live broadcast room, her eyes turned into crescent moon shapes, which were very beautiful.

As a result, more and more gifts were sent.

Then, Li Haiyan strolled into Time Restaurant.

When she saw the spacious area and the luxurious lamps, her mouth could not help but open wide. Her face was filled with admiration and shock.

“Wow! This is too beautiful!”

Then, she sniffed hard and said, “There’s also a very fragrant smell in the air.”

No one noticed that there was a faint hint of disdain at the corner of her mouth.

The comments in the live broadcast room started rolling again.

A Passerby on Earth: [It’s over, it’s over. Haiyan is starting to embarrass herself again.]

Winter JJ is too cold: [Haiyan, keep a low profile, keep a low profile! You’re in a big restaurant now.]

Solitude in the Sea: [Don’t ask too much of Haiyan. After all, she’s just a cute little girl.]

…

At this moment, the oval-faced waitress standing at the door smiled and said, “Welcome.”

Li Haiyan seemed to notice the waitress and praised again, “Is this a high-end restaurant? The waitress is so beautiful and sweet!”

Although she said that, her face revealed an imperceptible disdain.

In the live broadcast room…

Prologue Actor: [It’s over, it’s over… Haiyan is hopeless.]

Doctor’s Benevolent Heart: [Haiyan, you have to remember that you’re a big food streamer.]

…

The waitress blushed.

She had never been praised like this before.

Li Haiyan seemed to have discovered a new continent and said, “Wow! The beautiful lady blushed. She’s so cute.”

The oval-faced waitress stuttered, “Do you have an appointment?”

Li Haiyan said, “No, do I need to make an appointment here? Does that mean I can’t eat here today?”

“That’s not the case,” the oval-faced waitress said. “It’s just that you might not be able to take reserved seats.”

“As long as I can eat here today.” Li Haiyan let out a breath and gently patted her chest.

Then, Li Haiyan walked inside under the guidance of the female attendant.

When she passed by the small bridge in the middle of the restaurant and the lifelike white crane statue in the middle, she said in surprise, “Wow! There’s actually a small bridge and flowing water in the restaurant. Moreover, there’s a white crane! It’s so beautiful!

“I want to take a beautiful photo with the white crane.”

After saying that, she moved the phone to the white crane and herself, then pressed the shutter button.

Finally, Li Haiyan came to a seat by the window.

“What would you like to eat, Miss?” asked the waitress.

“I have to ask my fans first to see if there’s anything delicious.”

Then, her gaze fell on the live broadcast screen.

Nine Elements Infinity: [Beef! Time Restaurant’s M5 steak is their signature dish.]

PM: [Get 18 Delicacies, it’s super delicious!]

Smile: [10 pounds of lobster!]

MMMMM: [Yes, yes, yes, 10 pounds of lobsters and golden fish!]

…

Li Haiyan said, “I’ll get M5 steak, 18 Delicacies, 10 pounds of lobster, and golden fish… Hmm, give me a serving of soup too.”

The waitress could not help but say hesitantly, “Do you have any other friends coming?”

“No, I’m alone,” Li Haiyan said.

“Then these dishes might be a little too much…” the waitress reminded her kindly.

Long-winded!

Li Haiyan looked annoyed.

However, she still smiled and said, “It’s okay. I have a big appetite and eat a lot.”

Hearing this, the waitress did not say anything more. She said, “Okay, please wait a moment.”

In the live broadcast room…

Bin Bin: [The waitress was actually worried that Haiyan wouldn’t be able to finish her breakfast. She’s really underestimating Haiyan.]

MT: [Isn’t that so? Although Haiyan is small, her appetite is not small at all. This is also the reason why I can’t marry Haiyan. I can’t afford to take care of her.]

Big Man: [Get lost. You want to marry Haiyan? She’s mine!]

Temporary Commenter: [10 pounds of lobster! I really want to see what kind of expression Haiyan will have when she sees a lobster bigger than herself.]

…

It had to be said that the efficiency of Time Restaurant was extremely high.

Not long after, exquisite delicacies were served.

18 bowls were served for 18 Delicacies, and each bowl was very exquisite and small.

This was one of Time Restaurant’s signature dishes, 18 Delicacies.

“Wow!” Li Haiyan said excitedly. “I can’t even bear to eat such good food.”

After saying that, she picked up a bowl and put the food into her mouth.

“Yes! Delicious!”

…

In the live broadcast room.

Missing: [Why does such a beautiful woman look like she hasn’t eaten?]

Path of Asura: [Can’t bear to eat it? I could even see Haiyan drooling from the corner of her mouth.]

Mo Wentian: [Saliva? Where? Slurp!]

Mermaid Incarnation: [Haiyan, pay attention to your image. You’re a beauty. Why are you licking your fingers?]

…

Li Haiyan did not seem to notice the comments and continued to eat seriously.

However, without anyone noticing, she quietly threw a few of the bowls into the trash can.

At this moment, the M5 steak was served.

“Do you wish to pour the sauce on it?” the waitress asked.

Li Haiyan seemed to be completely attracted by the big, beautiful steak.

After a while, she finally reacted and said, “Ah, okay. Pour it, then.”

After the sauce was poured onto the steak, an alluring fragrance immediately wafted out.

Li Haiyan took a deep breath and said, “Wow! It smells so good!”

Then, she picked up her knife and fork and quickly cut a piece of beef into her mouth.

Immediately, Li Haiyan’s eyes widened as she praised, “Delicious!”

Then, she cut another piece of beef and put it into her mouth.

When she picked up the knife and fork again and was about to continue cutting the meat, she felt that it was too slow.

Hence, Li Haiyan picked up the entire steak with her hand.

“It’s so hot!”

She yelled twice and stuffed the big piece of beef into her mouth.

F*ck!

“Delicious! This is awesome!”
